title: ContactChange
description: Represents a change in a contact within Producerflow

agency_id.description: Always present. ID of the agency that the contact belongs to

contact_id.description: Always present. Unique identifier for the contact

first_name.description: Always present. First name of the contact

middle_name.description: Always present if filled in by tenant. Middle name of the contact

last_name.description: Always present. Last name of the contact

email.description: Always present. Email address of the contact

phone.description: Always present. Phone number of the contact

role.description: Always present. Role of the contact within the agency

street.description: Always present. Street address of the contact

address_line_2.description: Always present if filled in by tenant. Second line of the street address (e.g., apartment, suite, unit number)

city.description: Always present. City of the contact

state.description: Always present. State of the contact

zip.description: Always present. ZIP code of the contact

external_id.description: Always present if filled in by tenant. External identifier for the contact

npn.description: Always present if filled in by tenant. National Producer Number

external_metadata.description: Present when the contact has external metadata. Absent when the field is NULL. Contains tenant-specific metadata as key-value pairs allowing tenants to attach their own business attributes, computed values, or derived data to contacts
